name: file-type

frames.best_why: Clean view of the full icon grid and the recent-files list with no cursor covering anything.

tagline: Colour-coded file icons for document formats, with a recent-files list.
summary: A set of file-type icons in brand colours and several variants, picked by extension, file name or MIME type. The demo shows ten large icons above a recent-files list with names, editors and sizes.
appearance: A dark rounded card. Its top half is a five-by-two grid of small coloured document icons, each a folded page with a white extension label. A thin divider separates four file rows with a tiny matching icon, bold filename, grey edit line and right-aligned size.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves. Developers choose size, variant, label and glyph per icon, and a helper resolves a type from a filename, path or MIME string.
demo_content: Formats pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, jpg, mp4, mp3, zip, fig, html; recent files like Q3 board deck.pptx.
use_when: A file list, upload tray or document picker needs a recognisable coloured icon per format.
avoid_when: You need thumbnail previews or obscure formats; unknown types show a neutral page with a text label.
customise: Pass type, variant (outline, solid, light, mono), size, a custom label or glyph, and extra classes. The extension table is fixed in the source.
weight_why: Inline SVG pages with CSS-driven labels; no animation or continuous work.

a11y.note: Each icon has role img and a generated aria-label; being static, it has no keyboard or motion concern.

issues: Fully neutral types such as ZIP read as a plain pale page beside the coloured icons.
polish_why: Consistent folded-page shapes and clear labels; neutral types sit apart from the coloured set.
